(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define sorted-objs
      (sort (objects g 0)
        (lambda (a b)
          (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
                [else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]))))
    (define crops (map (lambda (o) (subgrid g (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o))) sorted-objs))
    (define out-h (apply max (map rows crops)))
    (define out-w (+ (apply + (map cols crops)) (max 0 (- (length crops) 1))))
    (let loop ([out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)] [remaining crops] [left 0])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (let ((crop (first remaining)))
            (loop (for*/fold ([acc out])
                              ([r (in-range (rows crop))]
                               [c (in-range (cols crop))])
                    (set-cell acc r (+ left c) (at crop r c)))
                  (rest remaining)
                  (+ left (cols crop) 1)))))))
